I’m 64 years old now, been farming these fields since I was 24. Never went to school, but I know this land better than anyone. My wife and me, we’re just two people now — our son works in Shijiazhuang, sends some money back but not much. We got 8.5 mu total, not much, but it’s what we have.

I split it like this: about 5.5 mu I do wheat then maize right after, the double crop. The other 3 mu I put in cotton. I’ve been doing this for years. The wheat went in last October like always, around the 10th or so. Now it’s April, the wheat is standing up green, and I need to topdress it soon.

**Wheat (5.5 mu):** Last year I put about 15 kg of urea per mu as base fertilizer before planting, and then another 10 kg per mu at jointing time. The yield was decent, around 450 kg per mu, better than my neighbor Lao Wang’s. So I’ll do the same this year. I already put the base fertilizer down last fall, so now I need to topdress. I’ll spread about 10 kg of urea per mu when the wheat starts jointing — that should be soon, maybe in the next week or two if the weather warms up. Then I’ll irrigate right after, probably twice more before harvest: once at jointing, once at heading if it stays dry. I don’t have much cash, so I won’t go crazy, but I’d rather put a little too much than too little. A bad wheat year hurts bad. I’ll probably spray once for weeds if I see them, and maybe once for insects if they show up. I expect around 450 kg per mu again, maybe 480 if the spring rain is good.

**Maize (5.5 mu, after wheat):** The maize goes in right after I cut the wheat in early June. I’ll plant local hybrid seed, the kind I buy from the shop in town. Costs me about 30 yuan per mu for seed. I put about 15 kg of compound fertilizer per mu as base, and then topdress with urea once when the maize is knee-high, maybe another 10 kg per mu. Last year I only irrigated once because pumping costs money — about 40 yuan each time for electricity. This year if it’s dry I’ll do two times, but only if I can afford it. Yield usually around 400 kg per mu, sometimes 450 if the rain is kind.

**Cotton (3 mu):** I’m planting cotton in a few days, around April 25th. I use the regular local cotton seed, not the fancy expensive kind. I put about 12 kg of compound fertilizer per mu in the ground before planting, then topdress once in July. Cotton needs water but not too much — I’ll irrigate twice, maybe three times if it’s very dry. I spray for insects more on cotton, those bollworms are terrible. Maybe two or three times. Last year I got about 280 kg per mu of seed cotton, hope for the same.

Labor is just me and my wife. She helps with spreading fertilizer and picking cotton, but the heavy work — plowing, irrigating — that’s me. I don’t hire labor, can’t afford it. We work every day. 

Money is tight. Total cash I can spend on inputs this season is maybe 2,500 yuan. I have to watch every cost. The well water costs electricity, and the price of fertilizer keeps going up. But I know if I cut too much, the yield drops and then we’re really in trouble. I’d rather spend a bit more on fertilizer than risk a bad year.
